title: Audit log silently drops security events on buffer full
description: core/src/audit.rs:126-129: AuditLoggerHandle::log() uses try_send; when the 1000-event buffer is full, the event is dropped with a tracing::warn and the function returns normally. The caller has no way to know security events (ArticleSigned, AuthAttempt, PeerBlacklisted) were not recorded. Under a brute-force attack, the auth events that should be the audit trail are exactly the ones that get dropped. → Operators will see 'audit log buffer full' in logs but their audit database will have gaps in the highest-pressure scenarios. Fix: either make the channel large enough that dropping is extremely unlikely, or change the API to return Result and let callers decide, or use a dedicated high-priority lane for security events.
